description:
Section 73 Application (Minor Material Amendment) to vary condition 5 (Operation Management Plans) and condition 6 (Private Hire) of Planning Consent ref: P2024/1540/FUL [Change of use and conversion of Grade II listed buildings known as the Engine House, Boiler House, Coal Store and Windmill Base from Class E (Commercial, Business and Service) to Class F1 (Learning and Non-Residential Institution) for gallery, exhibition and education use with ancillary shop, cafe and office uses. Occasional use as an events venue for private hire. Reconfiguration of North Stores and construction of foyer link between North Stores and main buildings. Provision of landscaping and public realm enhancements including creation of a pedestrian route through the Site. Reconfiguration of new vehicular and pedestrian access into the site from Amwell Street and pedestrian and servicing access from Myddelton Passage. External lighting scheme also proposed. (Joint Listed Building Consent submitted ref: P2024/1543/LBC)] dated 19/05/2025. 
The application seeks to specify event uses in Operation Management Plans and to increase the frequency of private hire (include Tuesdays).
